task: Behaviour: reading a 12-byte BITMAPCOREHEADER (OS/2 1.x / Win 2.x) BMP via public Image::readMetadata parsed its 16-bit width/height as 32-bit, so reported pixelWidth/Height were wrong; feature-impl handling of the short header. Library change single file src/bmpimage.cpp (+ test).
